_help: Settings for the weekly publication update. See README.md.
_extra_dois_help: DOIs to add by hand when OpenAlex has not linked them to Dr. Evanseck yet (e.g. new meeting abstracts). Example: ["10.1016/j.bpj.2025.11.1234"]
_abstract_journal_issns_help: Journals searched first in Crossref for meeting abstracts (0006-3495 = Biophysical Journal, where BPS abstracts are published).
_text_fixes_help: Corrections for garbled characters in OpenAlex data. Left side: text as it arrives (� is the broken-character symbol). Right side: what to show.

dissertations._help: Weekly check of Duquesne's dissertation archive for dissertations chaired by Dr. Evanseck.

covers._help: Weekly check for journal covers featuring the group's papers. Add a paper's DOI to 'hide' to remove a cover that was picked up by mistake.

duquesne_news._help: Weekly search of Duquesne's own news for stories that mention Dr. Evanseck or a current group member (see scripts/update_news.py). To hide a story, add its web address, or a few words from it, to 'hide'.

grs._help: Yearly Graduate Research Symposium check (scripts/update_grs.py). Every year found stays on the website; to take one off, add it to hide_years, e.g. [2027]. Photos named images/news/grs-<year>-1.jpg, -2.jpg ... are shown automatically.

instagram._help: The lab's Instagram posts (scripts/update_instagram.py). Needs the INSTAGRAM_TOKEN secret. To hide a post, add its link to 'hide'.

hall_of_fame._note: Slides in content/hall-of-fame are shown only if their text contains 'require'. 'fix' corrects spelling on the slides.

acs_meetings._help: ACS regional meetings (scripts/update_acs_meetings.py). The usual addresses (e.g. acscerm2026.org) are checked automatically; add a meeting's website to 'sites' if it uses another address. Programs don't list affiliations, so group members are recognized by name: everyone on the People page plus 'members'. To take a meeting off the website, add its short name (e.g. 'CERM 2026') to 'hide'.

bps._help: Biophysical Society Annual Meetings, made from the group's BPS abstracts (scripts/update_bps.py). To take a year off the website, add it to hide_years, e.g. [2027].
